messages:
ashley: Thanks for joining the all-hands — follow-up thread for hiring/org Qs. I'll capture concrete answers and owners.

ryan: Quick one  are we hiring net new this quarter or mostly backfills?

ashley: Net new but much more targeted. Goal: 10-15 net hires this quarter, focused on runtime (priority), platform (Console/SDK), and post-sales engineering. Finance final review on Fri.

megan: If my PM squad is consolidated, what happens to open reqs and active interviews?

ashley: Active interviews continue. Open reqs for deprioritized projects will be paused and posted internally as backfills where possible. Recruiting will reach out to live candidates re: timeline.

tom: Approval flow recap: hiring manager -> recruiting -> hiring council -> finance -> exec sign-off for net new. Aim to close standard reqs in ~12 business days. Critical runtime roles can be expedited.

isabel: Will there be any change to compensation or promotion schedules for folks who change teams?

ashley: No freeze. Promotions and comp cycles remain on-schedule. Team moves get a level-mapping within 7 business days; HR will run manager office hours next Tue/Wed.

ops-bot: Reminder: All hiring reqs must be entered into Greenhouse by EOD Thu to be considered for this cycle :bell:

ryan: Oncall/load concerns — merged squads might increase burden. Any mitigation?

megan: Leads will publish a temporary 4-week overlap rota and we'll add an extra SW-engineer float for infra-heavy weeks. If you're at cap, flag your manager; we'll prioritize backfill.

ashley: We'll also publish a weekly headcount snapshot in #finance. Example (will be auto-published):

```
snapshot_date: 2026-03-20
total_ftes: 160
open_reqs: 8 (4 awaiting council)
planned_net_new_q2: 10-15
priority_split: runtime=7, platform=3, post-sales=3
```

ryan: Thanks, that helps. One last: severance or layoffs contingency?

ashley: No planned layoffs. We have contingency playbooks if macro conditions change; leadership commits to transparent communication and notice windows.

ashley: Action items: HR to post level-mapping guide (owner: isabel), recruiting to publish req template (owner: tom), leads to share org charts by Mon (owner: megan). DM your manager for role-specific concerns. Thanks everyone :)
